easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent loses 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
